panels.description: 场内车辆数（最近一条 occupancy 快照）

targets.query:
from(bucket: "parking")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer" and r._field == "occupancy")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.site_id == "${site_id}")
  |> last()

panels.title: 当前在场车辆

panels.description: 剩余车位（capacity - occupancy，由设备端直接上报 free）

targets.query:
from(bucket: "parking")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer" and r._field == "free")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.site_id == "${site_id}")
  |> last()

panels.title: 剩余车位

targets.query:
from(bucket: "parking")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer" and (r._field == "in_today" or r._field == "out_today"))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.site_id == "${site_id}")
  |> last()

panels.description: 场内车辆数随时间变化（每相机一条曲线）

targets.query:
from(bucket: "parking")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer" and r._field == "occupancy")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.site_id == "${site_id}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 1m, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: 在场车辆数趋势

list.definition:
from(bucket: "parking")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "mqtt_consumer" and r._field == "occupancy")
  |> keep(columns: ["site_id"])
  |> distinct()
